authoring_status: Preregistered before any candidate/Model payload; sources and Models are static data. Runtime execution remains root-owned.

classification_rules.clean: No public unresolved blockers and exact required_argv.
classification_rules.refuse: At least one explicit public unresolved blocker; absence of rows alone is insufficient.
classification_rules.permitted-refusal: An explicit public blocker is permitted; otherwise exact required_argv is required.

oracle_execution_contract.namespace: Fresh independent namespace/class for every Model projection.
oracle_execution_contract.observation: Observe _events and return value; catch final TypeError outside test_static. Never execute sensitive source or derive Model by replacing its sink.
oracle_execution_contract.source_handling: AST-only sensitive source; real derive_design_review input after root dispatch.

cases.contract_basis: Reached protected write after current enclosing-cell read requires an explicit blocker.
Finite eager comprehension and literal local-helper call; result is not consumed. The false effect branch stays dormant and the fixed sink remains lawful.
Class-local first iterable reaches the implicit body, whose armed read resolves to the enclosing function and reaches a protected write.
The actual class-local first iterable has only False; the implicit read/body is dormant. Preserve ordinary finite comprehension nonexecution and exact fixed sink.
Generator first iterable is obtained in class context at creation; later consumption must retain current enclosing-cell authority, or explicitly refuse the unsupported deferred route.

No broader class-result/deferred precision promise: an explicit blocker is permitted. If unblocked, the current enclosing cell is False despite class and consuming-helper shadows, so exact fixed argv is required.
